exposure: Uterine artery embolization combined with uterine aspiration
ultrasound-guided local lauromacrogol injection combined with uterine aspiration
cohort: 499 women treated for CSP at Taizhou Hospital between January 2009 and December 2018
finding: A long-term follow-up of women after CSP treatment showed a high successful fertility rate, but also an increased CSP recurrence rate.
